dataset.name: Nutrition5k
dataset.fetch_mode: selective per-file fetch, no archive download
dataset.integrity: sha256 recorded per file at fetch time (imagery_manifest.jsonl)

known_corrupt_source_files.policy: counted as depth-unavailable for that dish

dataset.license: CC BY 4.0 (bucket README.md, quoted in ATTRIBUTION.md)

protocol.dev_carve: 2,360 train / 395 dev, clustered by plate (20 s scan-timestamp gap), candidates wholly inside official rgb train
protocol.test_usage: official RGB test with overhead imagery (507 dishes = official depth test), evaluated once
protocol.estimator_selection: dev-only; HistGradientBoostingRegressor selected for every arm
protocol.zero_target_policy: zeros kept in MAE/bias/nMAE, excluded from relative-error and coverage, counted in n_zero

not_executed: vision-LLM endpoint arm (src/vision_endpoint.py) - no authorized GEMINI_API_KEY in environment; budget-gated, refused to run without credential
iOS on-device runtime validation (numpy reference implementation only)
